title: How to get involved in AI safety

cues.en: This will be a short video where I just want to give you a few recommendations for learning more about AI safety.
cues.zh: 這支很短，只推薦幾個深入了解 AI 安全的方向。

cues.en: If you are not interested in the topic directly and are satisfied with what I've introduced so far in
cues.zh: 如果沒特別興趣，覺得本章

cues.en: this section, then that's great and I'm happy that you know a little bit more about AI safety issues than you did before this section.
cues.zh: 介紹已足夠，很好，也很高興你比之前更了解一些。

cues.en: Perhaps you feel like AI safety is an important issue and you want to look for more information, more
cues.zh: 也許覺得重要，想找更多資訊、

cues.en: training opportunities, or even career opportunities in this field.
cues.zh: 訓練，甚至職涯機會。

cues.en: Well, the first step to learning more about getting involved in AI safety is just to learn more about it.
cues.zh: 想參與，第一步就是多了解。

cues.en: I think that as AI continues to integrate into almost every aspect of our lives, having some basic
cues.zh: AI 持續融入幾乎全部生活，基本的

cues.en: proficiency in AI safety is going to become like proficiency in other aspects of privacy and security,
cues.zh: 安全素養，會像其他隱私、資安知識一樣重要，

cues.en: like knowing that you shouldn't use the same password for all of your accounts and so on.
cues.zh: 例如知道不同帳號不該用同一密碼。

cues.en: Of course, there are tons of YouTube videos, websites, podcasts, and so on where you can learn both high level overviews like what I presented in this section.
cues.zh: YouTube、網站、Podcast 等，有很多像本章的高層概觀。

cues.en: And you can also hear people discuss these issues in a ton of detail in hours long podcasts or recorded seminars that you can find on YouTube, for example.
cues.zh: 也能在幾小時的 Podcast、錄影研討會等，聽深入討論。

cues.en: And just some simple web searching will return lots of relevant hits.
cues.zh: 簡單搜尋，就有大量相關結果。

cues.en: You can also talk to other people about AI safety.
cues.zh: 也可以與別人談 AI 安全。

cues.en: This is a great way just to spread awareness amongst your friends and family and community, that there is such a thing as AI safety and it is important.
cues.zh: 讓親友、社群知道這件事存在、很重要，是很好的方式。

cues.en: And if you are considering or just curious about opportunities for careers in AI safety, then there
cues.zh: 如果考慮或好奇職涯，

cues.en: is a ton of opportunities and they are not all technical and deeply mathematical.
cues.zh: 機會很多，不全是技術、深入數學。

cues.en: There are important legal policy advising.
cues.zh: 法律、政策建議，

cues.en: Educational outreach and so on.
cues.zh: 教育推廣等等，也重要。

cues.en: Lots of positions and opportunities for people with different backgrounds and interests and expertises
cues.zh: 不同背景、興趣、專長都有職位與機會，

cues.en: to try to help make AI more safe and more beneficial, with fewer risks and less harm.
cues.zh: 幫助 AI 更安全、有益，減少傷害風險。

cues.en: There are also fellowships and internships and jobs available in the field of AI safety.
cues.zh: 也有研究獎助、實習與工作。

cues.en: If you really want to dedicate your professional time to this issue, and in this slide, I'm going
cues.zh: 如果真的想投入專業時間，這張會

cues.en: to highlight four of the many websites that I think are good starting places for learning about and getting involved in AI safety.
cues.zh: 介紹眾多網站中的四個，作為了解、參與的起點。

cues.en: These are by no means all of the useful websites, but they're just some of the big ones for getting started.
cues.zh: 不是全部有用網站，只是幾個大型入門資源。

cues.en: This website is called 80,000 hours, and it's like a information portal and advising website for people
cues.zh: 這個叫 80,000 Hours，是資訊、諮詢網站，服務

cues.en: who want to dedicate their careers to some useful and impactful cause.
cues.zh: 想把職涯投入有用、具影響力議題的人。

cues.en: This website is not exclusively about AI safety, but they do have a big focus on AI safety.
cues.zh: 不只談 AI 安全，但非常重視。

cues.en: And then there is the center for AI safety, which is an organization in the US, the AI Safety Institute.
cues.zh: 再來是美國的 Center for AI Safety；AI Safety Institute，

cues.en: This is like the UK version.
cues.zh: 像英國版。

cues.en: And the European AI office is obviously the EU version of this endeavor.
cues.zh: European AI Office，則顯然是歐盟的相關機構。

cues.en: There are also lots of other organizations and companies that are mostly or entirely focused on various
cues.zh: 還有很多組織、公司，主要或全部聚焦

cues.en: solutions and approaches to AI safety.
cues.zh: AI 安全的各種解法與方法。

cues.en: So that's it for this video.
cues.zh: 這支就到這裡。

cues.en: If you are not at all interested in technical AI safety, then I hope you feel that this section was a useful and quick overview of that field.
cues.zh: 若對技術安全沒興趣，希望本章仍是實用、快速的領域概觀。

cues.en: And if you are interested in this topic, then I hope that you've gotten enough resources that you can continue learning in as much depth as you would like.
cues.zh: 若有興趣，希望這些資源足以讓你按需要繼續深入。

cues.en: Elsewhere in the next section, I will introduce mechanistic interpretability, and that is going to be the focus of the rest of this course.
cues.zh: 接著下一章，介紹機制可解釋性，也是剩下課程的重點。
